ns2:course.label: Design and Use of Biomaterials
ns2:course.description: Characterization and use of biomaterials in medical applications. Concepts of biocompatibility in terms of structure and properties of materials and interactions between materials and proteins, cells, and tissue. Issues related to the design of biomaterials. Design of biomaterials to meet specific medical needs. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in both MCB 252 and either CHEM 232 or MSE 403.
